This lack of detail makes it challenging to fully understand the implications of the proposed Tri-scan approach and its computational trade-offs. This lack of mechanistic understanding weakens the claims made about Mamba's advantages. To address the identified weaknesses, I recommend several concrete improvements. First, the authors should significantly broaden the scope of their baseline comparisons. This deeper mechanistic understanding would strengthen the claims made about Mamba's advantages and provide valuable insights for future research.
